Koh Tao is where bubbles meet brilliance. Shallow reefs, granite pinnacles, curious turtles & the chance of whale sharks make every dive feel personal. Add its laid-back island vibe & world-famous dive scene, & you’ll see why it’s iconic. 🤿🐋 #KohTao #KoTao #Scuba #Diving #Thailand #adventure #tra…

Video taken at Koh Tao (Turtle Island), a small, stunning island in Thailand's Gulf.
